gaps.explanation: p5 (printed p16) governmental funds statement: Transfers in General 5,190 + Street 2,515 = 7,705 (JSON statement). Detail General Fund lines come from the departmental combining statement pp15-16 (printed p49), which prints transfers between General Fund departments gross: Administrative 5,190 + Police 54,683 + Park 17,813 = 77,686 (Total column), plus Street 2,515 = 80,201. The extra 54,683 + 17,813 = 72,496 are intra-General-Fund departmental transfers, matched by the Administrative transfers out (129,846) vs the fund's (57,350); the fund statement nets them. All printed lines; no fix.

p5 (printed p16): Transfers out General (57,350) + Other Governmental (7,705) = 65,055 (JSON statement). Detail: General Fund Administrative department (129,846) (p15, combining statement of General Fund departments, Total column (129,846)) + Keno Fund (7,705) = 137,551. 129,846 - 57,350 = 72,496 = transfers to the Police (54,683) and Park (17,813) departments inside the General Fund, printed gross on the departmental schedule and netted on the fund statement. No fix.

pp8-9 (printed p18, two halves) Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds: Electric, Water (p8), Sewer, Trash, Golf (p9) Fund columns; no business-type schedule exists. JSON business-type receipts = 2,439,365 + 51,846 + interest 30,613 + franchise fees 60,000 = 2,581,824. Added per column: Electric 1,484,373 + 8,998 + 27,157 = 1,520,528; Water 295,718 + 30,827 + 1,340 = 327,885; Sewer 282,187 + 938 = 283,125; Trash 215,880 + 550 = 216,430; Golf 161,207 + 12,021 + 628 + 60,000 = 233,856; total 2,581,824 (gap 0).
